session: This round was opened by the SESSION as M0-e-03's HARDENING ROUND S6 (J237 (2): the M0 hardening phase's fix rounds, batched per owning item; J238: M0 is the bedrock — the default for an M0 row is FIX with an exact precaution and a pin; J567: the bar is an independent closing check's PASS on the evidence), on THE CONTRACTS ROUND's consumer row for RL13 (queue Q205; the inventory's L26; docs/validation/hardening-retriage-2026-10-19/B7.md's 'L26 (reader of a-05's structured refusal)'; J803 R6): the water stage reads the refused body from the kernel's structured field, never from its text. Each 'failing line' below is one such row — an open queue row routed to this item (docs/M0-FIX-QUEUE.md) or a row the item's latest closing check wrote into its notes file; its evidence names the SOURCE you MUST read whole before fixing; the fix shape and the pin are the session's reading, binding unless the source or the code shows it wrong — then say so in your notes and do what the finding needs. THE RULES OF A HARDENING ROUND: (1) inside the item's owns and nowhere else — a row that needs another item's file is REPORTED, not built; (2) every row gets a PIN (a test that is red without the fix; your mutant table shows each pin killing its mutant) unless the row is comment-only or asks for a choices row — then the text is the deliverable; (3) BEHAVIOUR: a hardening fix may move output where a defect is fixed — a DECLARED shift, stated in your choices row with the before and after (digests and goldens re-recorded in the same round, named), never silent; where a row offers alternatives, take the one the design's text supports and say which; a change of an operation's or stage's CONTRACT (its design-level behaviour, a record or file format, an exported API) is NOT yours — report it as a note for the session's ruling and leave the row at REPORTED; (4) J264 / N-58: the refusal census of the item's registered families before and after the round, never rising (a row whose fix makes a lawful input succeed lowers it and says so); (5) API frozen (J263 Q1): no export of a folder index or the barrel added, removed or renamed unless a row explicitly asks for one — then the index change is the row's and stated; message texts pinned verbatim where a row changes one (J263 Q6); (6) the gates, NEAR and RELATED@1000 as the brief above says, at W=1; (7) the item's notes file gains a section 'Hardening round S6' with the row-by-row outcome (fixed / pinned / reported, each with its evidence and mutant), and the round's choices row names every row it closes. The CLOSING CHECKER confirms every row's outcome with its own evidence (re-reading the source note or queue row), re-kills every pin's mutant, re-measures the refusal census, and judges new findings by the blocker rule only; a row left REPORTED with a stated contract reason is not a failing line. THIS IS LEG 2 OF A MERGED ROUND OF THREE LEGS — THE CONTRACTS ROUND, M0-a-06's (the MERGED-ROUND RULE, J443; J803 R1, R2): M0-a-06 S11 → M0-e-03 S6 → M0-c-04 S8, in that order, on ONE tree and ONE branch, no reset between, each leg with its own build, closing check, LANDED line and record; EACH LEG LAUNCHES ONLY IF THE LEG BEFORE IT PASSED (ok with check.verdict pass) — legs 2 and 3 share no file, but @plat/layout depends on @plat/site, so a failed leg 2 must never sit under leg 3's gates: a failure HANDS BACK, and the session launches what is left. Legs 2 and 3 also wait on the landings of the rounds now in flight on their items (M0-e-03 S5, child EA; M0-c-04 S7, child EC). The round carries no leg of M0-a-05: the refusal that names a body is made by the transaction at commit (kernel/src/tx/tx.ts roleProblems → run → reject), and a plan that commits nothing for a SEQUENCE of splits is a dry run, which only tx/ can open and undo (docs/validation/a05-contracts-spec-2026-11-13/draft.md §0, §1.1, §1.3 (c)). Its neighbour: Q181's round is M0-a-06 S12 (J803 R1; its drafted entry docs/validation/q181-ruling-2026-11-12/spec-a06-s11.json keeps its file name), specced on the head that holds this round's leg 1 and the RQ2 round's third leg; it lands after this round and re-takes its own baselines there. RULINGS BINDING (each ledger row read by its own grep, never the 1.3 MB file whole: grep '^| J637 ', '^| J648 ', '^| J800 ', '^| J803 ', '^| J263 ', '^| J264 ', '^| J238 ' docs/PROGRESS.md; and grep 'RL13\|RL15' docs/validation/hardening-retriage-2026-11-09/plan.md): J803 (docs/validation/a05-contracts-spec-2026-11-13/rulings-final.md, read WHOLE: R1 – R13 and 'The fold'; it replaces rulings-provisional.md, which is not read as binding; where a line below and the rulings file disagree, the rulings file binds and the seat says so in its notes). RL13 (J637 (3); queue Q205): a STRUCTURED FIELD on the kernel's refusal naming the refused body — YES, ADDITIVE — its home `TxResult` in tx/types.ts, read by path (R4), set only by the transaction's own commit rows (R5); M0-e-03 reads it, `shore` only (R6). RL15 (J648; queue Q135): the always-rejected planning batch of S5a's gate plan is replaced by the kernel's plan that commits nothing — the DRY RUN, `dryRun` in tx/tx.ts and the façade member `Kernel.dryRun` built NOW by leg 1's cross-item scope (R7, R13); the seam kernel of S5a refuses it (R8); the double work is accepted as a named cost of S5 (R3). J800 (2)–(3): Q135 stays M0's (J238 (1)) and is bound with RL13 into this round. J263: Q1 — no export NAME of a folder index or the barrel is added, removed or renamed (the new types and functions are read BY PATH); the public surface that changes is said plainly — the `Kernel` interface's `tx` return type and its one new member `dryRun`, and the barrel's module-level `tx` signature (R4, R7); Q6 — every pinned message text stays verbatim. J264: zero refusals of lawful input — the refusal census of the item's registered families before and after, never rising. J238 (1)–(3): nothing is carried, narrowed or waived for pace. THIS SPEC TOOK ITS ADVERSARIAL REVIEW (J631 (2) (a)): docs/validation/a05-contracts-spec-2026-11-13/review/review.md — F1 – F13 and its fourteen numbered changes, folded here under J803; its probes (docs/validation/a05-contracts-spec-2026-11-13/review/probes/) and logs (docs/validation/a05-contracts-spec-2026-11-13/review/logs/) are evidence a seat may re-run in a mirror. The draft (docs/validation/a05-contracts-spec-2026-11-13/draft.md, with its §6 'Corrections after the review') and the first entries (docs/validation/a05-contracts-spec-2026-11-13/v1/) are evidence, never binding over this entry. THE GATE: the round opens on the design head AFTER M0-a-06 S10 (the RQ2 round's second leg, child ED, which edits tx/tx.ts `run` — it inserts the `shape` rows' maintenance at the commit) has landed; it reads nothing of the router round (M0-a-05 S14 – S16) and writes no file of it. Every cite below was read on the design head 102ff939 (insert/ on origin/wip/child-a05s14 @ 9354851f), BEFORE S10: the cites of tx/tx.ts `run` and its line numbers are re-read on your head; the files, functions and forms named are binding, the line numbers are not. The declared reds below are the head's list of 2026-11-13, brought by the session to the binding head's list before this entry is appended. DECLARED REDS OF THE HEAD, never a failing line (brought to the head of 2026-11-13; where THE MEASURED LIST above names a red of the head differently, this list is the newer): Q152's six M0-a-09 bands tests; J176's Mac-reference bench tests (bench/test/calibrate, host, timing); bench/test/site/summary.test.ts's canary (J772 (7): the committed site summary is stale until the session's re-run — the compose.test.ts and spike.test.ts reds the measured list names beside it were re-pinned since by M0-e-06 S4 and are green); Q153's flake (testkit/test/determinism/dilation.test.ts; re-run alone); and Q202 — the seven 'later rungs' cases of packages/layout/test/enceinte/s5seeds.test.ts, which register only at FULL strength (PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS unset; at 1 000 runs the file reports 'No test found') and are red there since before this round was specced: another item's, re-pinned by a round in flight. THE RESTARTS (a fact of this platform on 2026-11-12 / 13: a container restarts about every two hours whether or not background tasks are live; /home/user/maps-scratch survives, every process dies, /tmp does not survive): every run over ten minutes is a STEP OF A RE-ENTRANT CHAIN under /home/user/maps-scratch/waves/ — its log and its exit-code file beside it, and for a run of many parts one exit-code file per part, so that a seat that comes back after a restart skips what is finished: the census one file per seed or family; RELATED@1000 IN CHUNKS — collect RELATED's own file list once (`vitest related --run` with the JSON reporter and a test-name filter that matches nothing, e.g. -t '^__no_such_test__$'), split it by 12 files, run each chunk with `vitest run --passWithNoTests` at PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS=1000 under ONE recorded PLAT_FUZZ_SEED, each chunk's JSON report and exit code beside it, the totals summed from the JSON reports (a file that registers no test at 1 000 runs is named); NEAR one run per project; each mutant its own exit-code file. A CHECKPOINT line names the chain's directory and its next unfinished step at least every twenty minutes of the seat's own work. No timing bar is judged on these machines. THE SEATS: the session's tiers for a stage item (J390 / J631 / J714), named at launch; the CLOSING CHECK is the STRONGER checker's — this leg changes SOURCE. THE WAITING RULE and the waiter as the brief above says. LEG 2's OWN TEXT. The write scope is the item's owns: plat/packages/site/src/water/ and plat/packages/site/test/water/ — nothing else; kernel/, layout/, testkit/ and bench/ are read and run, never edited. Leg 1's `refused` field (tx/types.ts TxResult, through `Kernel['tx']`) is on your tree: read leg 1's notes section 'Hardening round S11' and its pins first. THE DECLARED SHIFT (J803 R6): ONE BEHAVIOUR CHANGE on a branch no run has reached — on an assertion-class text that prints `(shore, water:estuary:<n>, 0)` (arena/rows.ts's 'already carries' check, made a refusal by insertChain's INVARIANT_THROW and prefixed by waterBatch) the regular expression dropped the estuary under the non-id `water:estuary:<n>, 0` and ran the river again; with the field the stage stops and refuses — the right behaviour, pinned (P6); nothing else moves, as LINE 1 shows. THE ORDER OF WORK: the equivalence oracle first (green on the base, where the reader is still the regex), then the reader and its pins, then the before / after. THE LIST FOR THE SESSION'S SEAMS (written in the notes, never edited here): queue Q205 and L26 (closed by this leg if it passes); docs/validation/hardening-retriage-2026-10-19/B7.md's L26 row; any other item's test that moves (owner, file, test, before, after). Notes section 'Hardening round S6'; verdict plat/docs/build/checks/M0-e-03-s6.md; lanes build/M0-e-03-fix-s6 / check/M0-e-03-close-s6 (free at this writing; re-keyed by the session if a key appears); ledger ids the next free at build time.

lines.required_change: FIX: waterFaces keeps the batch's `refused` on its refusal (present only when the kernel's result carried it; the text unchanged); the `Attempt` failure arm gains `refused?: RoleKey`, carried by water() from waterFaces (absent on the polygon refusals water() makes itself); runS1 reads `const named = attempt.refused?.role === 'shore' ? attempt.refused.entity : undefined;` — SHORE ONLY (R6) — and the regex and its 'message contract' comment go, the comment saying the stage reads the kernel's structured field (RL13). Every refusal text of the stage byte-identical. THE PLANT (how the naming line is reached, never the retry): a façade over the test's kernel that refuses EVERY S1 water batch (`kernel.tx` with S1's L0 spec, after the outer ring's batch) in which the named body's shore was inserted (its `geom.insertChain` wrapped to see the rows), with the planted refusal below, until that body is gone — so the slow-only retry is refused too and the loop reaches the naming line; every pin that drops a body asserts the final `report.retried === false` (the last attempt is the fast one made after the drop: the naming path, not the retry). PINS (site/test/water/, the consumer side of the seam), each with the mutant only it kills: (P1) the planted refusal `{ ok: false, code: 'E_INVARIANT', detail: 'planted: this text names no body', refused: { role: 'shore', entity: 'water:tributary:0', ordinal: 0 } }` on a river and a tributary: the tributary is dropped `refused`, the river commits, `retried === false` — M1 the body branch never drops (it stops where `at > 0`); (P2) the same naming `water:river:0`: the stage refuses E_INVARIANT with the 'no further rung' text, nothing of the water written — M2 `riverRefused` not set (at 0 read as no name: the stage's other refusal text); (P3) on a fixture with a mouth, the estuary named by the field: `mouth` none, the estuary dropped `refused`, the river kept whole, `retried === false` — M3 the estuary branch removed (the estuary is no standing body: the stage stops); (P4) a text that prints `(shore, water:tributary:0) branches (planted)` with NO field: the stage stops as for an unnamed refusal, nothing dropped — M4 the regex kept as a FALLBACK for the BODY branch where the field is absent (P1 – P3 carry the field, P6 is the estuary branch: all green); (P5) `refused: { role: 'bank', entity: 'water:tributary:0', ordinal: 0 }`: the stage stops, nothing dropped — M5 the role filter removed; (P6, J803 R6, review F4) with a mouth set, the text `S1 water: water:estuary:0 ring 0.0: arena: the element already carries (shore, water:estuary:0, 0)` with NO field: the stage stops and refuses with that refusal, the estuary NOT dropped and no `water:estuary:0, 0` in `report.dropped` — red with the regex (the estuary branch fires on the non-id) — M6 the regex kept as a FALLBACK for the ESTUARY branch where the field is absent (P4 is the body branch, P3 carries the field: green). M7 (waterFaces drops the field) is killed by P1 – P3 together — a guard of the carry, no pin of its own owed. EQUIVALENCE ORACLE (a test keeping the old regex as its oracle; a NO-SHIFT witness, not a pin — no mutant owed): over the runs below, a façade watching every S1 water batch asserts for each refusal that the TRANSACTION's own rows made, and for each refusal whose text holds no `(shore, `, `regexName(detail) === (refused?.role === 'shore' ? refused.entity : undefined)`, and states how many named refusals it saw and how often the naming line was visited (the review saw 10 named refusals and one visit on the EP-01/S1 cells, none on the site families). NO-SHIFT, SHOWN, NARROWED (R6) to every refusal the transaction's own rows make and every text with no `(shore, `: before (the base: leg 1 landed, the regex reader) and after, at one recorded seed — x-06's EP-01/S1 cells (five kinds × their seeds: each run's handling, rung, code and detail), the item's exit-bar seeds and NEAR families, and a DECLARED site sample at the TEST size (relief-60 and relief-3000 × default and coarse × seeds 1–8, the review's sample: per seed the S1 report's `dropped`, `retried` and `fallbacks`, every S1 refusal's code and detail, and the L0 level digest at S1's end) with relief-60 and relief-3000 default × seeds 1–3 at CITY beside it — identical; the item's refusal census identical (J264).
